frequencyResponse: inherits YURIKA DSP; amp deviation <= 0.02 dB from 20 Hz to 20 kHz
notes: Power figures are software reference values and do not mean the PC physically delivers this wattage to a 6-ohm load.
Amp residual distortion/noise is added to the existing processed signal; combined THD+N is a power-domain composition, not a replacement measurement.
Neutral (Flat) automatically bypasses amp residuals to preserve the existing transparency gate.
